purpose: Reduce recurrent time and token costs of extending and maintaining pi-compose while preserving development quality and approved product decisions.

requirements.text: Observe pi-compose maintenance work automatically without per-task user commands.
Use Task, optional Step and actual Run identities; forecast P30/P50/P80 before implementation and preserve provenance.
Measure time and observable tokens without inventing missing usage, and retain failed/reworked runs.
After development delivery run inexpensive analysis and queue valuable independent improvement work.
Prefer architectural root-cause fixes over gates, AI instructions and user behavior when safe and economical.
Apply only allowlisted, independently verified improvements in isolated worktrees; never auto-push remote main or silently change product decisions.
Compare improvement cost and later outcomes; do not claim causal time/token savings without sufficient evidence.
Keep Task and verification/approval states machine-readable in JSON; keep explanatory material in Markdown.

included: pi-compose project development, checks and test environment
excluded: developing upstream Pi or Codex source code
turning the internal harness into a generic product
Context Hub, MCP and architecture-philosophy knowledge services
automatic changes to approved pi-compose product decisions
